results.name: Scheduled retention covers old/boundary/straddling/recent/incomplete/legacy/current/invalid/late and auxiliary records
Manual and scheduled execution select equivalent rows and preserve exactly the same run categories
Overlapping scheduled invocations are safe and do not double-delete
Unavailable D1 and query failure reject with bounded failure report and no deletion
Scheduled transaction failure rolls back all changes and remains visibly failed
Missing/contradictory policy, invalid/future scheduler context and invalid trusted time cannot delete
Manual routes require distinct maintenance and admin credentials; internal Worker handler needs neither secret
Current and legacy export policy context stay distinct; no measurement schema change
Bounded operation reporting has only permitted fields and excludes run/event identifiers, payloads and secrets
Late new arrival protects a run while a duplicate-only batch cannot extend raw event retention
Schedule/policy/provider/research wording drift negatives fail without changing source files
